60-N-T-10.foot_frame: the foot body's frame at home (world-aligned)
60-N-T-10.claw_question: A rigid foot pitched heel-up about its toe pad's front edge touches the floor with the middle claw at 0.08 rad (60 cm) / 0.07 rad (75 cm) and then rolls on the claw tip, as digit III does in birds; the reference rolls it so, over a short transition arc (no part below the floor).  The plant has no contact on the claws (contype 0), so in simulation the claw passes through the floor and a controller cannot load it; on the hardware the claw tip would carry the trailing foot's load through the roll.  For the owner: a load-bearing claw tip (and claw contact in the plant), a shorter claw (the roll then stays on the pad edge), or a toe-off capped near 0.07-0.08 rad.

75-M-H-10.foot_frame: the foot body's frame at home (world-aligned)
75-M-H-10.claw_question: A rigid foot pitched heel-up about its toe pad's front edge touches the floor with the middle claw at 0.08 rad (60 cm) / 0.07 rad (75 cm) and then rolls on the claw tip, as digit III does in birds; the reference rolls it so, over a short transition arc (no part below the floor).  The plant has no contact on the claws (contype 0), so in simulation the claw passes through the floor and a controller cannot load it; on the hardware the claw tip would carry the trailing foot's load through the roll.  For the owner: a load-bearing claw tip (and claw contact in the plant), a shorter claw (the roll then stays on the pad edge), or a toe-off capped near 0.07-0.08 rad.

F1 bob.range: 50-100 % of the enforced stance-leg shortening (0.007-0.014 H nominal, 0.013-0.026 H at the animal pace)
F1 bob.rule: bob = 0.75 (duty stride / 2)^2 / (2 (1 - crouch) H) with V0's duty and stride at that speed, held from V1 to V6; V1B50 and V1B100 take 50 % and 100 %
F1 bob.drift: F3's longer stance (nominal) and F13's stride (75 cm, animal pace) enforce more shortening, so the same bob is a smaller share of the rung's own: about 57 % on the nominal V2-V6 and 55 % on the 75 cm animal-pace V6 (measured per rung: bob_share_of_enforced)

F1 bob_phase.range: hips at today's height at mid single support

F2 bob_drop.range: settling over 0.1-0.15 s; a quick dip then a slow rise
F2 bob_drop.rule: hold the crest through late single support, drop (min-jerk) over 0.1 s to the trough, rise (min-jerk) to the next mid-stance; at the faster walks the drop starts before the touchdown (a 0.1 s drop after it would need more than g downward)

F3 swing_time.range: the animal-pace walk's swing time, 0.32 s at 60 cm and 0.36 s at 75 cm
F3 swing_time.rule: (1 - envelope.FAST.duty) x the Froude 0.05 walk's period on the body
F3 swing_time.owner_decision_2: at the nominal walk the duty is 0.69, outside the spec's 0.55-0.65 band: the nominal V2+ rungs need the band widened to 0.72 below 0.30 m/s (owner decision 2), else F3 starts at the brisk walk

F4 lift_peak.rule: gait.lift_profile: sin^2(pi g(s)), g = s + A s^2 (1 - s)^4, keeping 0.46 of the lift at 75 % of the swing (the clearance screen's 0.04 H with the 0.10 H lift)

F5 toe_off.rule: the range's low end: the knee's late-stance speed follows the roll's rate, and 0.40 rad by lift-off takes the knee to 0.98-0.99 of its speed limit at the nominal walk (V3T: 0.40 rad at 4.5 rad/s and 290 rad/s^2)

F5 toe_off_rate.rule: the 60 cm nominal walk's roll (0.30 rad over its 93 ms on the floor, 3.2 rad/s), with room for F14's jitter (rolls up to 4 % shorter) so both nominal walks reach 0.30 on every step; where the floor roll is shorter (0.40 m/s, the animal pace) the toe-off is what the roll reaches by lift-off within this rate and toe_off_accel, and the pitch only falls after it (no heel flick in the air)

F5 toe_off_accel.rule: the same roll's min-jerk peak pitch acceleration (5.77 x 0.30 / 0.093^2 = 199, with the same room for jitter): the 23-38 ms rolls at 0.40 m/s and the animal pace reach 0.02-0.06 rad by lift-off; a 0.12 rad roll there whips the shank (the CoM's vertical acceleration near 10 m/s^2)

F5 toe_off_margin.rule: the roll waits until the ZMP reference is 5 mm inside the rolling support (the trailing toe pad's front edge and the leading foot's pads); every rolling frame is checked against its actual contact (the edge or the claw tip)

F5 pivot.range: toes roll up; digit III pivots on its claw
F5 pivot.value: toe pad edge, a transition arc, then the middle claw tip (gait.roll_offset)
F5 pivot.rule: A rigid foot pitched heel-up about its toe pad's front edge touches the floor with the middle claw at 0.08 rad (60 cm) / 0.07 rad (75 cm) and then rolls on the claw tip, as digit III does in birds; the reference rolls it so, over a short transition arc (no part below the floor).  The plant has no contact on the claws (contype 0), so in simulation the claw passes through the floor and a controller cannot load it; on the hardware the claw tip would carry the trailing foot's load through the roll.  For the owner: a load-bearing claw tip (and claw contact in the plant), a shorter claw (the roll then stays on the pad edge), or a toe-off capped near 0.07-0.08 rad.

F6 roll_amp.rule: toward the stance leg at its mid-stance (V4); V4L the other way

F9 tail_phase.range: the phase minimising the stance foot's yaw moment
F9 tail_phase.rule: tail_check on V4 per body and speed: the peak |M_z| of the single-support stance pad

F13 stride_rel.range: 0.85-0.90 H at the animal pace, 75 cm only
F13 stride_rel.rule: V5F13 adds it to V5 with its own tail phase (tail_check on V4 with this stride); V6 adds F14 to V5F13 there

F14 tail_var.rule: the tail amplitude drifts over F9's 0.10-0.15 rad (0.125 +- 20 %)

zmp_iters.rule: look rungs (V1 on) run 12 multibody-ZMP correction passes: the bob and the toe-off slow the convergence (60-N-T-10 animal-pace V3: 3.2 mm after 6, 1.9 mm after 12; V0 1.95 mm after 6)
zmp_iters.effect_alone: V1 changes the passes as well as adding F1/F2; V0 regenerated at 12 passes measures what the passes alone change, at the sub-millimetre level of the CoM path (look_refs.json checks.<body>.<speed>.zmp_passes)

v040.rule: the gait the brisk_to_fr05 speed change passes through at 0.40 m/s: period, duty and lift mixed with the speed's weight (transitions.py)
